sync.title: Sync your notes
sync.description: Keep devices in sync through a folder your file-sync tool replicates, or a ZIP you carry over. Everything merges locally — nothing leaves your devices.
sync.folderHint: Point it at a folder Syncthing, Nextcloud or Dropbox replicates. The app re-scans it in the background when the window regains focus.
sync.noFsa: This browser can't connect a live folder (File System Access API). Use the ZIP flow below — on Chromium desktop you get folder mode.
sync.zipHint: Merging pulls in new pages and updates; when both devices edited a page, the newer one wins and the other survives as a “(conflict …)” copy.
